# `aitbc confidential balance`

Show a confidential wallet balance proof.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc confidential balance [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet-id` | text | — | yes | Wallet ID. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc confidential balance --wallet-id <wallet_id>
```
